flow: Manual template → Evaluate Email → Change Difficulty → Very difficult → Apply Revised Email
purpose: Test revision direction toward harder-to-detect phishing and application of the accepted revised email.

generation_context.organization_context: Windropolis uses centrally managed email accounts.

evaluation_context.situation_context: No mailbox closure campaign is expected.

change_difficulty.feedback: Keep the same mailbox scenario, but make the message subtler and more realistic.

steps: Paste the supplied obvious email and evaluate it.
Select Very difficult, Max iterations 3, and paste the provided feedback.
expected_invariants: At least one revision attempt is made unless the initial result already matches the target.
Accepted revision moves toward a harder-to-detect route rather than adding more obvious cues.
Fixed sender/link context is not silently changed.
No new hardcoded absolute URL is introduced by the revision.
Apply Revised Email copies the accepted email back into the main editor.
